card.name: Hyphen-D in high-dose, single-dose
card.fires_on: The hyphen plus the letter D (or a space and D) that starts the word dose after a modifier such as high or single. It appears in drug-label headings and dosing text.

modes.label: High-dose
modes.description: The "-D" of dose in "high-dose" before methotrexate or corticosteroids.
modes.example: Rescue After High<<-D>>ose Methotrexate Therapy The recommended

modes.label: Single-dose
modes.description: The "-D" of dose in "single-dose" vials, syringes or containers.
modes.example: Preparation and Administration Instructions Single<<-D>>ose Prefilled Syringe Take the V

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the compound as "dose", though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the "d" that begins "dose" in terms like high-dose and single-dose.
